description: This file is a FastAPI router module defining API endpoints for managing connectors. It includes endpoints for listing connectors, fetching metadata, performing searches, creating entities, listing projects and spaces, and providing LLM tool support commands. The file heavily relies on external classes, methods, and data models, integrating with a connector registry, tenant context, and audit logging.

classes.name: SearchBody
classes.description: Data model for proxy search requests, including provider, query, tenant, connection, limit, cursor, and extra parameters.

classes.name: CreateBody
classes.description: Data model for proxy create requests, including provider, tenant, connection, kind, payload, and extra parameters.

classes.name: ToolInvokeBody
classes.description: Data model for LLM tool invocation requests, supporting different tools like search, create, projects, and spaces.

methods.name: list_connectors(ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Lists all registered connectors with their keys and descriptors.

methods.name: get_connector_metadata( provider: str = Path(..., description="Connector key, e.g. 'jira' or 'confluence'"), ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), )
methods.description: Retrieves the descriptor or metadata for a specific connector provider.

methods.name: SearchResponse proxy_search(body: SearchBody, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Proxies a search request to a specified connector provider.

methods.name: CreateResponse proxy_create(body: CreateBody, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Proxies a create entity request to a specified connector provider.

methods.name: MetadataResponse list_projects( provider: str = Path(..., description="Connector key."), tenant_id: str = Query(..., description="Tenant id."), connection_id: str = Query(..., description="Connection id."), ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), )
methods.description: Lists projects for a connector provider by delegating to the provider metadata.

methods.name: MetadataResponse list_spaces( provider: str = Path(..., description="Connector key."), tenant_id: str = Query(..., description="Tenant id."), connection_id: str = Query(..., description="Connection id."), ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), )
methods.description: Lists spaces for a connector provider via metadata delegation.

methods.name: llm_tools_discovery()
methods.description: Provides a list of available LLM tools and usage notes.

methods.name: llm_tool_proxy(body: ToolInvokeBody, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Proxies generic LLM tool requests ('search', 'create', 'projects', 'spaces') to respective provider operations.
